email_phishing_defenses_layered.title: Layered Email Phishing Defenses
email_phishing_defenses_layered.description: Layered email phishing defenses at perimeter - DMARC enforce, link rewriting, attachment sandboxing, safe-browsing.

user_awareness_training_current.title: User Awareness Training Current
user_awareness_training_current.description: Phishing-resistance posture current and measurable; training within 12 months plus simulated phish with measured posture trend.

managed_device_enrollment_enforced.title: Managed Device Enrollment Enforced
managed_device_enrollment_enforced.description: Every device touching corp resources is MDM/UEM-enrolled with verified device identity.

network_access_control_802_1x_enforced.title: 802.1X Network Access Control Enforced
network_access_control_802_1x_enforced.description: Corp wired ports and wifi SSIDs enforce 802.1X / cert-based NAC; no open or PSK corp networks.

user_segment_isolated_from_production_ti.title: User Segment Isolated From Production
user_segment_isolated_from_production_ti.description: User VLAN firewalled from prod data tier; endpoints reach data only via app gateways/jump hosts.

admin_protocols_require_pam_and_mfa.title: Admin Protocols Require PAM and MFA
admin_protocols_require_pam_and_mfa.description: Admin remote-access protocols (RDP/SMB/WinRM/SSH/VNC) terminate at PAM-mediated jump host with MFA and session recording.

third_party_access_scoped_and_audited.title: Third-Party Access Scoped and Audited
third_party_access_scoped_and_audited.description: Contractor/MSP/partner access is time-boxed, scope-limited, audit-logged end-to-end.

third_party_devices_meet_same_posture_ba.title: Third-Party Devices Meet Same Posture Bar
third_party_devices_meet_same_posture_ba.description: Vendor/contractor endpoints crossing boundary meet same MDM/EDR/patch posture as employee devices.

endpoint_full_disk_encryption_on.title: Endpoint Full-Disk Encryption On
endpoint_full_disk_encryption_on.description: Every corp endpoint enforces FDE (BitLocker/FileVault/dm-crypt/LUKS) with central recovery-key escrow.

remote_wipe_and_lost_device_response_tes.title: Remote Wipe and Lost-Device Response Tested
remote_wipe_and_lost_device_response_tes.description: MDM remote-wipe capability exists AND lost-device runbook exercised end-to-end within 12 months.

edr_agent_active_with_tamper_protection.title: EDR Agent Active With Tamper Protection
edr_agent_active_with_tamper_protection.description: Every in-scope endpoint runs centrally-managed EDR/XDR, healthy, streaming off-box, with tamper-protection enabled.

endpoint_to_endpoint_smb_rdp_restricted.title: Endpoint-to-Endpoint SMB/RDP Restricted
endpoint_to_endpoint_smb_rdp_restricted.description: SMB/RDP/WinRM between user-segment endpoints blocked or tightly restricted; no flat L2 ransomware propagation path.

endpoint_runs_as_least_privileged_user.title: Endpoint Runs As Least-Privileged User
endpoint_runs_as_least_privileged_user.description: Day-to-day user accounts are non-admin; local-admin gated through separate named/LAPS/JIT-PAM.

session_binding_or_short_session_lifetim.title: Session Binding or Short Session Lifetime
session_binding_or_short_session_lifetim.description: SSO sessions cryptographically bound to device (DPoP/mTLS/WebAuthn-bound) OR short-lived (<=24h with conditional-access re-eval).

endpoint_audit_logs_centralised.title: Endpoint Audit Logs Centralised
endpoint_audit_logs_centralised.description: Sign-ins / privilege elevation / EDR detections / USB insertion / policy drift shipped off-box to central SIEM with >=90 day retention.
